One of the most memorable parts of my journey was my Arangetram, because that is when I truly became a more confident dancer. My guru trained my dance partner and me for almost 6 months, helping us improve our stamina, stance and overall performance. She especially helped me with abhinaya, which was something I struggled with a lot. Every small mistake was corrected patiently, and she made sure we kept improving in every class. What made this experience even more special was that my guru made sure our Arangetram was budget-friendly while still being beautifully organised and well managed. It was a very meaningful and unforgettable experience for me.
Another wonderful part of learning here is the opportunities the school provides. Students get chances for performances, scholarships, auditions, and even opportunities to perform across India and abroad. The annual festival “Atharvotsav” is also one of the highlights of the year. It gives students and artists a great platform to perform, learn and gain confidence while celebrating this beautiful art form.

Classical dance is not always easy and there are many challenging moments, but having a teacher you can trust and learn from makes all the difference. Our guru has always guided and supported us with patience, discipline and encouragement.

For me, Atharva School of Fine Arts is much more than just a dance class. It is a place where I learned dance, discipline, confidence and grew into a better version of myself.

featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience with Atharva School of Fine Arts, under the guidance of my respected guru Srimati Shamal Pawar, has been truly wonderful and life-changing. I feel extremely grateful to have been learning Bharatanatyam here for the past 7–8 years. This institution is not just a dance class; it is a place where students learn discipline, dedication, cultural values, and a deep respect for the beautiful art form of Bharatanatyam.

I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to Srimati Shamal Pawar, who has been teaching Bharatanatyam for more than 30 years with immense passion and dedication. Her teaching style reflects both deep knowledge of the art and genuine care for her students. From the very beginning, she has guided us with patience, attention to detail, and constant encouragement, helping us understand not just the steps but also the expressions, emotions, and meaning behind each movement.

One of the most memorable milestones of my journey here was performing my Arangetram, which was also the 10th Arangetram organized by the school. Preparing for this was an intense and beautiful journey. For nearly six months, our guru trained us tirelessly, correcting every small detail and encouraging us to give our best. The amount of effort, patience, and dedication she showed during the entire preparation was truly admirable.

What made the Arangetram even more special was how thoughtfully it was organized. The event was beautifully planned and executed, yet kept budget-friendly, considering the perspective of students and their families. Our guru truly believes that every dedicated student deserves the opportunity to perform their Arangetram, and she makes sure that this dream becomes possible for everyone.

The live orchestra team was also exceptional. Their music added great depth and beauty to the performance and made the entire Arangetram experience feel even more traditional and powerful. The coordination between the musicians and the dancer was seamless, and their contribution played a huge role in making the performance memorable.

Apart from being an incredible teacher, Smt.Shamal Pawar is also a very kind and compassionate person. During a difficult phase when I was facing a financial crisis, she supported me and continued to teach me free of charge for several months. This gesture meant a lot to me and my family, and it shows how deeply she cares about her students.

The facilities at Atharva School of Fine Arts are also very good. The classrooms are clean, spacious, and well air-conditioned, making practice comfortable even during long sessions. The school also provides proper washroom facilities and drinking water, ensuring a pleasant learning environment for all students.

What I appreciate the most is that dance is never taught mechanically here. Our guru always emphasizes discipline, expressions, and understanding the deeper essence of Bharatanatyam. Through her guidance, students grow not only as dancers but also as confident and disciplined individuals.

Looking back on these 7–8 years, I feel extremely grateful for everything I have learned here. My Arangetram was not just a performance but a celebration of years of dedication, guidance, and blessings from my guru.

I wholeheartedly recommend Atharva School of Fine Arts to anyone who wishes to learn Bharatanatyam sincerely. My heartfelt thanks to Smt. Shamal Pawar, the wonderful orchestra team, and the entire management for their dedication and efforts. I feel truly privileged to have been trained under such an inspiring guru and to have been part of this beautiful journey.❤️🙏
